Name: Application Security Verification Standard Project
Description: The Application Security Verification Standard provides a basis for testing web application technical security controls.

Requirements.Name: Architecture, Design and Threat Modeling
Requirements.Description: Requirements for secure architecture, design, and threat modeling practices.

Items.verification_requirement: Verify the use of a secure software development lifecycle that addresses security in all phases.
Verify that security requirements are defined and tracked as part of release planning.
Verify that all software components are identified and their provenance is tracked.

Requirements.Name: Authentication Verification Requirements
Requirements.Description: Requirements to establish secure and resilient authentication controls.

Items.verification_requirement: Verify that user passwords are at least 12 characters in length for normal accounts.
Verify that account lockout or rate limiting is implemented for repeated failed authentication attempts.
